jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Docker

Docker has been one of the most loved brands in developer tooling, trusted by more than 20 million monthly users and over 20 billion container image pulls. From solo founders to the world's largest companies, developers rely on Docker to build, share, and run their applications across our suite of products including Docker Desktop, Docker Hub, and Docker Scout.

We are a globally distributed, remote-first team building the tools that define how software gets built and delivered. As AI agents redefine software development, Docker is at the center of that shift, providing the sandboxed environments, verified images, and secure infrastructure that make autonomous workflows trustworthy by default.

_______________________________________________________________________

Docker is launching a Professional Services organization to accelerate customer success, reduce time-to-value, and drive enterprise adoption for agentic workloads. As a Principal Solution Architect, you'll play a critical role in building and scaling this function. You will join a team of seasoned experts with deep experience backed by Docker's unmatched reach across Fortune 500 companies.

This is a high-visibility role working directly with senior leadership across revenue, product, marketing, and partner organizations. You'll shape service strategy, drive cross-functional alignment, and deliver offerings that accelerate both services revenue and platform expansion.

You'll serve as a trusted advisor to our largest and most strategic partners and enterprise customers, providing thought leadership on integrating Docker agentic solutions within enterprise environments.

Responsibilities

Build and Scale the Professional Services Practice

  • Develop and codify repeatable reference architecture patterns across Docker's core use cases including self-hosted and air-gapped deployments, MCP (model context protocol)/AI agent environments, IDP integrations, and secure supply chain workflows so that engagements scale consistently across customers and partners.

  • Translate reference architectures into customer-facing technical collateral, SOW templates, and success patterns that reduce scoping time and improve delivery consistency.

  • Collaborate with product, marketing, and revenue teams to integrate services into GTM motions and align delivery to Docker's AI platform roadmap.

  • Identify offerings that drive product expansion, renewals, and long-term customer value.

  • Support Partnerships & Alliances in selecting, onboarding, and enabling technical integration partners, system integrators (SIs), and service delivery partners.

Drive Strategic Customer Outcomes

  • Act as a trusted advisor to enterprise customers, helping them adopt modern patterns for containerization, AI workflows, and secure software supply chains.

  • Lead technical discovery and architecture engagements that span enterprise integration layers

  • Architect and deliver self-hosted Docker deployments within air-gapped, regulated, and complex enterprise environments including local image registry setup, offline toolchain configuration, and compliance-driven infrastructure design.

  • Design and Guide customers through implementation of agentic AI toolchains, including MCP server/client architecture, tool orchestration, observability integration and secure deployment patterns aligned to Docker's AI platform.

  • Position Docker as a strategic and thought leadership partner, influencing long-term technology adoption and investment decisions.

  • Directly deliver or assign and oversee appropriate delivery partners to execute service engagements and ensure technical objectives are met.

Enable Cross-Functional Success

  • Drive alignment and decision-making across multiple stakeholders and teams without direct reporting lines.

  • Translate field insights including enterprise integration patterns, IDP/SSO friction points, observability gaps, and AI deployment challenges into actionable product and services strategy, roadmap, and partner capabilities.

Qualifications

Required

  • 7+ years as a Professional Services Solution Architect, Technical Consultant, or similar role at a SaaS/infrastructure company or consulting firm.

  • Demonstrated experience architecting and deploying self-hosted and air-gapped deployment architectures: local image registries, offline toolchain configuration, network-isolated Kubernetes clusters, and compliance-driven infrastructure constraints common in regulated industries.

  • Enterprise integration experience across Identity Providers (Okta, Azure AD, LDAP/Active Directory) and federated identity protocols (OIDC, SAML, SSO), including RBAC design within complex, multi-tenant enterprise environments.

  • Working knowledge of Model Context Protocol (MCP) and its application to agentic AI toolchains including MCP server/client architecture, tool and resource orchestration, and secure containerized deployment patterns.

  • Hands-on experience with AI/ML workflows, LLM deployment, and agentic AI architectures in enterprise environments with awareness of Docker's AI platform roadmap including AI agent containerization, model provenance, and AI supply chain security.

  • Deep understanding of container and software supply chain security: Docker Hardened Images (DHI), Secure Supply Chain (SSC), SBOM generation, image signing and attestation, vulnerability management, and runtime governance.

  • Excellent facilitation and stakeholder management skills; able to lead executive-level architecture conversations and influence senior stakeholders without formal authority.

  • Direct experience delivering high-quality services engagements that achieve customer value while meeting revenue and ARR growth targets within a revenue organization.

  • Recognition by enterprise customers as a strategic technical advisor.

Bonus

  • Experience architecting AI platforms in large enterprise environments LLM deployment pipelines, model provenance, artifact signing, and secure AI supply chain patterns.

  • Background enabling system integrators, consultancies, or partner ecosystems.

  • Consulting experience with Fortune 500 clients in highly regulated sectors such as financial services, healthcare, or government.

  • Led AI security architecture engagements that addressed model provenance, artifact signing, and supply chain integrity for containerized AI workloads including secure MCP server deployment, tool and resource access controls, secrets management within agentic pipelines, and runtime isolation patterns for LLM-based applications.

What to Expect

First 30 Days

  • Onboard to Docker's mission, values, and operating model.

  • Deeply familiarize yourself with our product portfolio, AI platform roadmap, and strategic customers.

  • Build strong partnerships with Product, Engineering, and Sales functions.

  • Plug into the team's rhythm of business (standups, reviews, shadow customer engagements).

First 90 Days

  • Scope, define SOWs, delivery, and oversight of customer service engagements.

  • Participate in the creation of reference architectures for key use cases..

  • Participate in initiatives to build out and improve the services department's offerings.

One-Year Outlook

  • Successful delivery and oversight of customer service engagements.

  • Contribute materially to the build-out of Docker's service offerings across AI, security, and enterprise integration practices.

  • Institutionalize continuous improvement by providing field feedback including enterprise integration patterns, deployment blockers, and observability gaps to the product team.

Docker does not offer visa sponsorship for this role.

 

Compensation & Equity

EU: €119K – €170K + equity

______________________________________________________________________

  • Open vacancy: This posting is for an existing open role.

  • AI in hiring: Docker may use AI-assisted tools during our recruiting process.

  • Interview recordings: Candidates will be invited to opt in to interview recordings to support interviewer calibration and consistent evaluations. Recordings are optional and require explicit consent.

______________________________________________________________________

Perks & Benefits

  • Remote-first by design – Work from your home, with offices in Seattle and Paris for connection and collaboration.

  • Flexibility that fits your life – We trust you to manage your schedule while delivering great work.

  • Time to recharge – Generous PTO, designated quarterly Whaleness Days, and a designated end-of-year Whaleness break.

  • Home office support – Set up your workspace for comfort and success.

  • Technology stipend – Equivalent to US$100 net per month to help support your work.

  • Learning & development – Annual stipend for conferences, courses, certifications, and continued learning.

  • Parental leave – 16 weeks of paid parental leave after six months of employment.

  • Equity for all full-time employees – Share in Docker's long-term success as we continue to grow.

  • Comprehensive benefits – Medical, retirement, and paid holidays vary by country.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Docker

Docker has been one of the most loved brands in developer tooling, trusted by more than 20 million monthly users and over 20 billion container image pulls. From solo founders to the world's largest companies, developers rely on Docker to build, share, and run their applications across our suite of products including Docker Desktop, Docker Hub, and Docker Scout.

We are a globally distributed, remote-first team building the tools that define how software gets built and delivered. As AI agents redefine software development, Docker is at the center of that shift, providing the sandboxed environments, verified images, and secure infrastructure that make autonomous workflows trustworthy by default.

_______________________________________________________________________

The next wave of enterprise transformation is being built by the Global Systems Integrators and every one of them is racing to stand up AI transformation and AI governance practices for their clients. Docker's AI Governance strategy is the natural infrastructure layer underneath that motion, and we need a senior partner leader to make that connection real, commercially, at scale.

We're looking for a Principal, GSI & SI Partnerships to build and lead Docker's engagement with the world's largest consultancies and systems integrators; Accenture, Deloitte, EY, KPMG, and others, as both a strategic force multiplier for our AI Governance narrative and a tactical revenue engine through co-sell.

This is a dual-altitude role. At one level, you are the executive relationship-holder who gets Docker a seat at the table inside GSI AI practices; shaping how they build, package, and go to market with AI transformation offerings. At the other, you are the operator who turns those relationships into pipeline: enabling sales teams, building joint plays, and driving deals to close. You will define how Docker becomes the trusted infrastructure partner GSIs build their AI consultancy motions on top of and how they make money doing it.

Key Stakeholders & Cross-Functional Partnerships

  • Primary: CRO and Sales Leadership; Global Alliances Leadership; Partner Leadership Team

  • Primary: Professional Services, Field Sales and Solutions Engineering teams (co-sell enablement and execution)

  • Secondary: Product Marketing, Demand Generation, Ecosystem Marketing

  • Secondary: Cloud & Channel Partnerships, Technology Alliances, Product Management

  • External: Accenture, Deloitte, EY, KPMG, and other GSIs/SIs including their AI/GenAI practice leadership, industry verticals, and delivery organizations

Responsibilities

GSI Strategy & Executive Engagement

  • Own Docker's global GSI/SI partnership strategy, prioritizing and sequencing engagement across Accenture, Deloitte, EY, KPMG, and other top-tier consultancies.

  • Build and sustain executive-level relationships with GSI AI/GenAI practice leaders, identifying where Docker's AI Governance capabilities plug directly into their existing AI transformation and consulting offerings.

  • Develop the strategic narrative and business case that positions Docker as the infrastructure and governance layer GSIs need to de-risk and scale their clients' AI initiatives.

  • Represent Docker in executive briefings, QBRs, and joint planning sessions with GSI leadership, establishing Docker as a preferred, differentiated partner rather than a vendor line item.

  • Partner with Professional Services and field teams to both share appropriate service assets and build the service’s capabilities Docker needs in the partner ecosystem to serve our mutual customers.

Commercial Model & Monetization

  • Design and articulate a clear "how GSIs make money with Docker" story, connecting Docker's AI Governance platform to GSI services revenue, delivery methodologies, and staffing models.

  • Build joint solution offerings and packaged plays with GSIs that combine their advisory/delivery capability with Docker's platform, creating a repeatable, sellable motion for both sides.

  • Negotiate and structure commercial frameworks (referral, resale, co-delivery) that align incentives and make Docker an attractive, profitable practice area for GSI partners. Align with Professional Services to build the service partner capacity needed to augment PS.

Tactical GTM & Co-Sell Execution

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Docker

Docker has been one of the most loved brands in developer tooling, trusted by more than 20 million monthly users and over 20 billion container image pulls. From solo founders to the world's largest companies, developers rely on Docker to build, share, and run their applications across our suite of products including Docker Desktop, Docker Hub, and Docker Scout.

We are a globally distributed, remote-first team building the tools that define how software gets built and delivered. As AI agents redefine software development, Docker is at the center of that shift, providing the sandboxed environments, verified images, and secure infrastructure that make autonomous workflows trustworthy by default.

_______________________________________________________________________

As a Senior Technical Account Manager (TAM) at Docker, you will serve as a trusted advisor to our most strategic customers, ensuring they realize measurable value from their investment in Docker’s platform. TAMs are responsible for guiding adoption, managing technical relationships, and influencing customer outcomes across the post-sales lifecycle.

This role sits within Docker’s Customer Engineering Group, which unifies pre- and post-sales technical teams to deliver a seamless, outcomes-driven customer experience. You’ll collaborate closely with Solutions Engineers, Engagement Services, and Product teams to help customers accelerate time-to-value, reduce friction, and achieve long-term success with Docker.

Responsibilities

Customer Success and Adoption

  • Build strong relationships with assigned enterprise customers, understanding their technical landscape, priorities, and success criteria.

  • Drive product adoption and operational maturity, aligning Docker capabilities to customer objectives and outcomes.

  • Conduct regular technical and business reviews to demonstrate value realization and identify opportunities for growth.

  • Anticipate risks and blockers, developing mitigation plans in partnership with customer and internal teams.

Technical Engagement and Collaboration

  • Serve as the primary post-sales technical contact and advocate for assigned accounts, connecting customer feedback to Product, Engineering, and Support.

  • Partner with Solutions Engineers to ensure smooth handoff from pre-sales to onboarding and sustained success thereafter.

  • Create and share reusable best practices, reference architectures, and technical playbooks that scale customer success.

  • Provide proactive guidance on containerization, CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, and emerging developer productivity trends.

Operational Excellence

  • Maintain high-quality documentation of customer engagements, health status, and progress toward success metrics.

  • Contribute to a consistent TAM engagement model, leveraging standardized processes for onboarding, health reviews, and renewals.

  • Support development of scalable initiatives such as 1:many workshops and digital enablement programs.

Qualifications

  • 4+ years in a customer-facing technical role (e.g., TAM, Solutions Architect, DevOps Consultant, Customer Engineer).

  • Strong understanding of Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, IaC, and cloud-native development practices.

  • Proven ability to translate technical capabilities into business outcomes and drive measurable customer value.

  • Excellent communication skills across both technical and executive audiences.

  • Skilled at identifying patterns and building long-term strategies beyond point solutions.

  • Comfortable working cross-functionally in a global, distributed organization.

Bonus Qualifications

  • Experience with developer-first platforms or PLG (product-led growth) models.

  • Familiarity with AI/ML infrastructure or agent-based development platforms.

  • Prior experience in post-sales or lifecycle management at an infrastructure or SaaS company.

What to Expect

First 30 Days

  • Complete onboarding and ramp-up training on Docker’s products, tools, and engagement frameworks.

  • Shadow experienced TAMs and Solution Engineers on customer calls to learn engagement rhythms.

  • Meet your portfolio of customers and understand their environments, goals, and success metrics.

  • Build relationships with internal partners including Support, Product, and Sales.

  • Review existing customer documentation and success plans to identify initial opportunities for impact.

First 90 Days

  • Take ownership of a customer portfolio and begin leading account engagements.
    Conduct your first technical or executive business reviews with guidance from your manager.

  • Establish a cadence of customer check-ins, documenting key success milestones and adoption progress.

  • Identify at least one process or content improvement that can scale customer engagement or reduce friction.

  • Contribute to cross-functional discussions that connect customer insights with product feedback.

One Year Outlook

  • Own the full lifecycle for a portfolio of strategic or enterprise customers, delivering measurable improvements in adoption and health scores.

  • Build executive relationships and serve as the customer’s voice within Docker.

  • Contribute to building the broader TAM engagement model through shared best practices and enablement resources.

  • Demonstrate impact through increased customer value realization, renewal success, and platform expansion.

  • Mentor new TAMs and participate in developing scalable frameworks for onboarding and customer engagement.

Docker does not offer visa sponsorship for this role.

 

Compensation & Equity

Canada: CA$201,600 – CA$288,000 OTE + equity

United States: $139,125 – $198,750 OTE + equity

______________________________________________________________________

Posting Information

  • Open vacancy: This posting is for an existing open role.

  • AI in hiring: Docker may use AI-assisted tools during our recruiting process.

  • Interview recordings: Candidates will be invited to opt in to interview recordings to support interviewer calibration and consistent evaluations. Recordings are optional and require explicit consent.

______________________________________________________________________

Perks & Benefits

  • Remote-first by design – Work from your home, with offices in Seattle and Paris for connection and collaboration.

  • Flexibility that fits your life – We trust you to manage your schedule while delivering great work.

  • Time to recharge – Generous PTO, designated quarterly Whaleness Days, and a designated end-of-year Whaleness break.

  • Home office support – Set up your workspace for comfort and success.

  • Technology stipend – Equivalent to US$100 net per month to help support your work.

  • Learning & development – Annual stipend for conferences, courses, certifications, and continued learning.

  • Parental leave – 16 weeks of paid parental leave after six months of employment.

  • Equity for all full-time employees – Share in Docker's long-term success as we continue to grow.

  • Comprehensive benefits – Medical, retirement, and paid holidays vary by country.

  • Docker swag – Because representing the whale never gets old.

Docker is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a team that reflects a broad range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe diverse teams build better products, make better decisions, and better serve our global community.

The Account Executive, Strategic, is responsible for managing and expanding relationships with key strategic accounts. This role involves a deep understanding of the client's business, the ability to develop strategic plans to increase revenue, and ensuring client satisfaction through excellent service. The ideal candidate will have a proven track record in sales, exceptional communication skills, and the ability to navigate complex negotiations.

Responsibilities

  • Client Relationship Management: Build and maintain strong, long-lasting customer relationships with strategic clients. Act as the main point of contact and advocate for client needs within the company.

  • Strategic Business Planning: Develop a thorough understanding of key client needs and requirements. Work closely with clients to devise and implement strategic plans that align with their business goals and drive mutual growth.

  • Sales Targets: Achieve and exceed sales quotas within assigned portfolio by identifying and closing business opportunities.

  • Market Analysis: Conduct research and analysis to understand industry trends, competitive landscape, and client feedback to inform strategic planning and identify new business opportunities.

  • Collaboration: with cross-functional teams (including marketing, product development, and customer service) to ensure a cohesive and comprehensive approach to market.

  • Reporting and Forecasting: Provide accurate forecasts and track key account metrics. Report on the status of accounts and transactions, and monitor sales performance against goals.

  • Contract Negotiation: Lead contract negotiations, ensuring favorable terms for both the client and the company.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years experience selling to large, complex F100 businesses, demonstrating a successful track record of meeting or exceeding targets, preferably in a similar industry or role.

  • Demonstrated ability to communicate, present, and influence credibly and effectively at all levels of the organization, including executive and C-level.

  • Experience delivering client-focused solutions to customer needs.

  • Proven ability to manage multiple account management projects at a time while maintaining sharp attention to detail.

  • Excellent listening, negotiation, and presentation abilities.

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.

  • Above and beyond: Trained in Command of the Message and MEDDPICC

What to expect

First 30 days:

  • Understanding the Company and Product: Gain a deep understanding of the company's products or services, value proposition, and the competitive landscape. This includes completing all necessary onboarding training and familiarizing oneself with the company culture and processes.

  • Relationship Building: Begin to establish relationships with key internal stakeholders, including sales, marketing, product, and customer support teams. Understanding their roles and how they can contribute to the success of strategic accounts is crucial.

  • Client Familiarization: Start to get acquainted with the portfolio of strategic accounts, including reviewing account histories, previous interactions, and current contracts or agreements. Initial meetings with some key clients may also take place to introduce yourself as their new point of contact.

First 90 Days:

  • Strategic Planning: Develop detailed strategic plans for each key account, identifying opportunities for growth, potential challenges, and strategic objectives. This should be done in collaboration with clients and internal teams.

  • Performance Metrics: Establish clear KPIs for success within your accounts, aligned with both client expectations and company goals. Begin tracking these metrics closely.

  • Sales and Negotiations: Start actively pursuing new business opportunities within strategic accounts, which may involve negotiating terms for contracts or renewals. Efforts to cross-sell or up-sell should also be underway.

  • Feedback Loop: Implement a process for regularly gathering and acting on client feedback to improve service delivery and client satisfaction.

One Year Outlook:

  • Achieving Sales Targets: By the one-year mark, you should have met or exceeded the initial sales targets set for your strategic accounts. This includes successfully closing new deals and expanding business within existing accounts.

  • Strategic Account Growth: Demonstrated growth in strategic accounts through increased engagement, higher revenue, and enhanced partnership levels. Your strategic planning and execution should result in tangible benefits for both the clients and your company.

  • Relationship Depth: At this point, you should have established deep, trust-based relationships with key stakeholders within each strategic account. You're seen as a strategic advisor rather than just a sales contact.

  • Process Improvements: Identification and implementation of process improvements based on lessons learned over the year to increase efficiency, customer satisfaction, and sales effectiveness.

  • Professional Development: Continued professional growth, possibly including leadership development, advanced sales strategies, and industry knowledge enhancement to better serve strategic accounts and contribute to the company's objectives.

Success in an Account Executive Strategic role is measured not just by sales figures but by the depth of relationships built, the strategic value delivered to clients, and the positive impact on the company’s long-term growth. Regular reviews against these expectations can help in identifying areas for improvement and adjusting strategies as necessary.

Docker does not offer visa sponsorship for this role.

Docker has been one of the most loved brands in developer tooling, trusted by more than 20 million monthly users and over 20 billion container image pulls. We are a globally distributed, remote-first team building the tools that define how software gets built and delivered. _______________________________________________________________________

We are seeking a highly consultative, commercially minded Senior Solutions Engineer, Mid-Enterprise to support our most strategic accounts. This role is a critical technical seller position, owning pre-sales technical strategy, shaping customer requirements early, and influencing outcomes in complex, competitive sales cycles.

You will act as a trusted technical advisor and champion owner, partnering closely with Account Executives, Post Sales, and Product teams to drive measurable business and technical value through

  • Technical Selling and Deal Shaping,

  • Technical Champion Ownership and Thought Leadership,

  • Customer and Internal Advocacy and

  • Competitive and Strategic Selling

This role reports to the Manager of Solutions Engineering and operates at the intersection of technical depth, business acumen, and competitive selling discipline.

Responsibilities

Technical Selling and Deal Shaping

  • Lead deep technical discovery across Platform Engineering, DevOps, Security, and AI/ML teams to understand:

    • AI governance requirements

    • Software supply chain risk posture

    • Regulatory and compliance drivers (e.g., NIST AI Risk Management Framework, EU AI Act.)

    • Secure development lifecycle requirements

  • Shape technical requirements early in the sales cycle to align customer outcomes with Docker’s differentiated value in AI governance, container security, and software supply chain integrity.

  • Design, position, and execute structured PoCs/PoVs focused on:

    • Policy enforcement

    • Image and artifact integrity

    • SBOM visibility

    • AI workload governance controls

    • Secure build pipelines

  • Develop custom code, scripts and integrations to help in customer environments

  • Define clear success criteria, evaluation frameworks, and executive-ready value summaries.

  • Influence decision-making through demos, workshops, architecture reviews, and technical executive briefings.

  • Translate complex AI security and governance capabilities into clear business value narratives for CISOs, Heads of Platform Engineering, and AI leaders.

AI Governance and Security Thought Leadership

  • Establish credibility as a trusted advisor on:

    • Responsible AI development practices

    • Secure AI model lifecycle management

    • Software supply chain integrity

    • Container and artifact security

    • DevSecOps best practices

  • Guide customers in implementing governance controls across AI-enabled SDLC workflows.

  • Provide architectural guidance for:

    • Agentic AI development environments

    • Policy-as-code enforcement

    • Identity and access governance for AI workloads

  • Act as a subject matter expert on secure software supply chain and AI security trends in customer-facing engagements.

Technical Champion Ownership and Thought Leadership:

  • Build, own, and expand relationships with technical champions across Security, DevOps, Platform, and AI teams.

  • Establish credibility as a trusted advisor through technical thought leadership, architectural guidance, and industry best practices.

  • Leverage champion relationships to influence broader buying groups, shape requirements, and uncover cross-sell and expansion opportunities.

  • Maintain engagement beyond initial sale ensuring outcomes are realized and leveraging insights to support future sales motions.

Customer and Internal Advocacy:

  • Advocate for customer needs with Product and Engineering, providing clear, actionable feedback informed by field experience.

  • Coordinate with Post Sales and Support resources to ensure continuity across the customer lifecycle.

  • Develop reusable technical assets (workshops, demos, reference architectures, enablement content) to scale impact across accounts.

Competitive and Strategic Selling:

  • Actively support competitive sales motions by identifying differentiation and influencing evaluation criteria throughout the sales cycle.

  • Partner with Sales to develop technical win strategies for strategic and competitive accounts.

Qualifications

  • Proven experience as a Sales Engineer, Solutions Engineer, or Solution Architect in complex enterprise sales.

  • Strong experience running competitive PoCs/PoVs with clearly defined success and exit criteria.

  • Ability to engage credibly with senior technical and business stakeholders.
    Solid understanding of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), containers, DevOps, and modern application architectures.

  • Love of developer tooling

  • Experience with Docker, container ecosystems, or adjacent technologies strongly preferred.

  • Development, Agentic AI dev, Software Development Lifecycle and/or Software Supply Chain experience strongly preferred.

  • Must be fluent in English

  • Excellent communication, influence, and stakeholder management skills.

  • Willingness to travel to customer sites up to 25%.

What to Expect

First 30 days

  • You will be welcomed with a first-in-class onboarding experience that includes equipment setup, a sweet swag package, and a collaborative training program working with an onboarding peer

  • You will learn how to navigate through award-winning sales tools such as: Salesforce, Opine, Sigma, and Docker.

  • Actively engage with senior stakeholders, and manage relationships with clients

  • You will work closely with your peers and partner with SEs to develop strategies to advocate for our customers.

  • At the end of your first month, you will have a proficient grasp of the tools and activities necessary to be successful in your role.

First 60 days

  • You will be laser-focused on supporting the sales teams during your second month.

  • You will have connected with all of your team members.

  • You will gain in-depth knowledge of Docker’s products and how they impact our customers.

  • You will have an advanced understanding of tools, activities, and best practices to be successful in your role.

First 90 days

  • In month three, you will be confident in your craft and ready to immerse yourself in our customer’s business needs fully.

  • You will continue efforts to improve messaging, processes, and activities.

  • Educate our clients about our product roadmap and undertake product training for users

  • You will be ready to operate independently at full speed.

Docker does not offer visa sponsorship for this role.

United States: $170.8K – $244K OTE + equity

  • Flexibility that fits your life – We trust you to manage your schedule while delivering great work.

  • Time to recharge – Generous PTO, designated quarterly Whaleness Days, and a designated end-of-year Whaleness break.

This manager level individual contributor will connect customer, campaign, product usage, and revenue data to help leaders improve conversion, prioritize investments, and accelerate pipeline growth.

Responsibilities:

  • Serve as the strategic analytics partner to Marketing, translating ambiguous questions into clear analyses, recommendations, and measurable actions.

  • Own lead and account funnel analytics, including conversion, velocity, quality, cohort performance, and the drivers of strong or weak outcomes.

  • Develop the targeting and measurement model for an inside sales motion into product led growth prospects.

  • Build account intelligence and scoring to support account based marketing, expansion, and new product adoption.

  • Lead the analytical narrative for Marketing QBRs, operating reviews, and planning, connecting activity to pipeline and revenue.

  • Design experiments and measurement plans that identify which programs and growth motions should scale, change, or stop.

  • Build scalable datasets, dashboards, and quality controls in partnership with Marketing Operations, Sales Operations, Finance, and Data teams.

Qualifications

  • 7 or more years of experience in marketing, growth, revenue, or GTM analytics, ideally in B2B SaaS.

  • Advanced SQL skills and experience with customer, campaign, product usage, CRM, and cloud warehouse data.

  • Strong knowledge of demand generation, funnel measurement, attribution, experimentation, account based marketing, and pipeline economics.

  • Ability to independently structure complex problems and deliver defensible, decision ready recommendations.

  • Experience building scalable dashboards and data products. Salesforce experience is strongly preferred.

  • Excellent executive communication, high standards for accuracy, and the ability to influence senior stakeholders without direct authority.

  • Comfort operating as a strategic, hands on individual contributor.

First 30 Days — Learn and Assess

  • Ramp on Salesforce, Snowflake, Sigma, and existing marketing reporting

  • Understand marketing programs, funnel definitions, attribution methodology, and end of quarter reporting processes

  • Build relationships with Marketing, Field Marketing, RevOps, Finance, and Data partners

  • Identify gaps in reporting coverage, data quality, and decision support

  • Support recurring and ad hoc analysis to build business context

First 60 Days — Own and Improve

  • Take ownership of core marketing reporting and end of quarter deliverables

  • Improve existing dashboards and reporting for accuracy, usability, and actionability

  • Establish a consistent support model and feedback loop with Field Marketing

  • Begin analysis of funnel conversion, campaign performance, and pipeline contribution

  • Align core marketing metrics and definitions across Marketing, RevOps, and Finance

First 90 Days — Deliver Insights and Impact

  • Independently deliver accurate, executive ready marketing reporting for QBRs and other business reviews

  • Provide actionable insights into funnel performance, pipeline creation, and marketing investment effectiveness

  • Deliver an initial priority analysis, such as Field Marketing ROI, ABM targeting, or PLG and ISR opportunity identification

  • Recommend improvements to marketing measurement, attribution, and investment decisions

  • Reduce recurring ad hoc requests through scalable dashboards and self service reporting

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Docker

Docker has been one of the most loved brands in developer tooling, trusted by more than 20 million monthly users and over 20 billion container image pulls. From solo founders to the world's largest companies, developers rely on Docker to build, share, and run their applications across our suite of products including Docker Desktop, Docker Hub, and Docker Scout.

We are a globally distributed, remote-first team building the tools that define how software gets built and delivered. As AI agents redefine software development, Docker is at the center of that shift, providing the sandboxed environments, verified images, and secure infrastructure that make autonomous workflows trustworthy by default.

_______________________________________________________________________

As a Senior Security Engineer, Offensive Security, you'll help drive offensive security at Docker, putting our products, platforms, and cloud infrastructure under realistic adversarial testing to surface and drive out attack paths before real adversaries find them. You'll partner with engineering, product, and leadership to turn findings into durable fixes and to shape how security is designed into every Docker product.

You'll apply your expertise in penetration testing, threat modeling, and exploit development to find and eliminate risks across Docker products and infrastructure. Working across cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, Azure), containerized environments, and AI/ML products, you'll implement proactive security solutions that scale with Docker's growth.

This role offers the opportunity to help improve security programs at a company whose products are trusted by millions of developers worldwide. You'll work in a fast-paced, technically challenging environment where your security expertise directly impacts both Docker's platform and the broader container ecosystem.

Responsibilities:

  • Contribute to security initiatives that align with business goals, helping ensure security is a core component of our products and infrastructure

  • Support and help implement key security programs such as automated security design reviews, and vulnerability management

  • Build deep knowledge of software security and architecture, and act as a go-to resource for engineering teams

  • Partner with engineering to design and implement security architecture and controls across Docker products and platforms

  • Plan, scope, and execute penetration tests and red-team / adversary-emulation engagements against Docker's products and services

  • Develop proof-of-concept exploits and produce clear, risk-rated findings with actionable remediation guidance, then retest fixes to confirm closure

  • Build and maintain offensive security tooling and automation to expand testing coverage and repeatability

  • Perform security reviews and threat modeling (design, architecture, and code) across Docker products and services, including emerging AI products, and write automated security tests and exploits

  • Serve on rotating on-call schedule to respond to security events, investigate threats, and coordinate remediation efforts

  • Educate and collaborate with cross-functional teams (e.g., engineering, product) to promote security practices

  • Participate in Security Incident response

Qualifications

  • Have 3+ years in security engineering, including hands-on offensive security and penetration testing across applications and infrastructure

  • Possess 2+ years of hands-on development experience in Python or Golang

  • Demonstrate deep expertise in authentication, authorization, including technologies like OAuth, cryptography applications and Zero Trust principles.

  • Have strong hands-on experience with securing cloud ecosystems (e.g. AWS, GCP, Azure)

  • Have hands-on penetration testing experience across SaaS web applications and APIs., including manual exploitation beyond automated scanners

  • Are proficient with offensive tooling and techniques such as. Burp Suite, and OWASP frameworks

  • Can write security tests and develop exploits and proof-of-concepts that find real vulnerabilities in a product

  • Understand AI/ML security risks and mitigations, including prompt injection, data poisoning, model extraction, and adversarial attacks

  • Have practical experience using LLMs and agentic tooling to automate vulnerability discovery, reconnaissance, and pentesting workflows

  • Have a track record of building security programs and automations from scratch, applying risk-based prioritization

  • Have experience performing security reviews and building or improving security review automation

  • Have excellent communication skills, allowing you to explain complex security concepts clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders

  • Understand industry standards, and actively keep up with emerging security technologies and models

  • Are a team player who drives security change via collaboration and cross-functional partnerships

  • Hold offensive security certifications such as OSCP, OSWE, OSEP, GXPN, GPEN, or CRTO

  • Have published CVEs, original security research, or conference talks

Bonus if you:

  • Have experience with container escape, Kubernetes attack paths, or cloud red teaming

  • Have experience testing AI/ML systems for issues like prompt injection, model extraction, and data poisoning

What to Expect

First 30 days:

  • Meet with security team and key partners across engineering

  • Gain access to team owned systems, and internal documentation

  • Complete security awareness training and compliance onboarding

  • Review application architecture, tech stack and data flow

  • Review risk registry and annual roadmap

  • Familiarize oneself with team workflows and processes

  • Shadow a fellow security engineer during their on-call/secops rotations

First 90 days:

  • Conduct security review on emerging Docker products

  • Scope and execute your first penetration test against a Docker product or service

  • Actively participate in architecture design reviews with the team

  • Contribute to a Security-owned project or initiative

  • Collaborate with Docker developers to validate and resolve discovered vulnerabilities

  • Enhance incident response capabilities by participating in on-call rotation and post-incident activities

  • Create and maintain security documentation and runbooks

First Year Outlook

  • Contribute to the security roadmap for improving security controls

  • Strengthen Zero Trust architecture and least privilege access controls

  • Enhance security monitoring and anomaly detection

  • Perform security reviews for major product releases

  • Own and run recurring penetration tests and adversary-emulation exercises across Docker products, and engage with external researchers

  • Support audits and ensure compliance with SOC 2, ISO 27xxx

  • Advocate for “security by design” in all product features

  • Become well versed in Docker products and emerging AI technologies

Docker does not offer visa sponsorship for this role.

 

Compensation & Equity

Canada: CA$271,150 – CA$434,000 + equity

United States: $194,150 – $312,950 + equity

Docker is seeking a highly organized, proactive, and people-focused Office Manager to lead operations for our new Seattle office. This role will be instrumental in building an engaging, productive, and inclusive workplace that reflects Docker’s culture and values.

You will serve as the go-to person for all things office related, partnering closely with People, IT, Finance, and executive leadership to ensure a seamless and welcoming environment for employees and visitors. Additionally, you will be the owner and driver of our partnership and collaboration with our facilities vendors and managers.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in fast-growing environments, enjoys building from the ground up, and takes pride in creating exceptional workplace experiences.

Office Operations & Facilities

  • Establish and manage daily operations of the Seattle office

  • Oversee facilities management, including landlord relations and maintenance coordination

  • Manage office vendors (cleaning, security, utilities, catering, supplies, etc.)

  • Develop and maintain office budgets in partnership with Finance

  • Ensure compliance with local regulations and workplace safety standards

  • Create and maintain operational processes and documentation

Workplace Experience & Culture

  • Foster a welcoming, inclusive, and engaging office environment

  • Plan and execute on-site events, team gatherings, and cultural initiatives

  • Partner with People team and IT team to support onboarding and employee engagement

  • Serve as a culture ambassador, aligning the physical workspace with Docker’s values

Office Visitation & Usage Support

  • Support visiting executives, leadership, and customers with logistics and coordination

  • Manage office access systems and badging

  • Coordinate conference rooms, shared spaces, and workspace assignments

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Collaborate with IT on equipment provisioning, office technology, and troubleshooting

  • Partner with People and Talent teams to support hiring growth in Seattle

  • Coordinate with global office operations to ensure consistency across locations

  • Contribute to workplace policies and future office planning initiatives

  • 8 + years of experience in office management, facilities management, or workplace operations

  • Experience launching or scaling a new office location strongly preferred

  • Strong vendor management and budget oversight experience

  • Excellent organizational and project management skills

  • High level of discretion and professionalism

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills

  • Ability to work independently and make decisions in a fast-paced environment

  • Experience working in a technology company or high-growth environment preferred

  • Proficiency with workplace management tools and common office software platforms

What to Expect

  • A high-impact, highly visible role in building Docker’s Seattle presence

  • Opportunity to design and shape the employee workplace experience from day one

  • Cross-functional collaboration with leadership and global teams

  • A fast-paced, growth-oriented environment

  • Autonomy, ownership, and the ability to influence how our workplace evolves

  • Develop a deep understanding of Docker’s culture, values, and operating model

  • Assess the current state of the Seattle office (space, vendors, systems, needs)

  • Build relationships with key stakeholders (People, IT, Finance, leadership)

  • Establish vendor contacts and ensure operational continuity

  • Identify immediate improvements and quick wins

First 90 Days

  • Implement standardized office operations processes and documentation

  • Finalize vendor agreements and optimize service levels
    Launch regular workplace experience initiatives (events, engagement programs)

  • Establish budget tracking and reporting mechanisms

  • Ensure onboarding experience is seamless for new Seattle hires

First Year

  • Successfully scale office operations to support team growth

  • Optimize space utilization and workplace systems

  • Build a strong, connected Seattle office culture aligned with Docker values

  • Establish a long-term facilities and growth plan

  • Serve as a trusted partner to leadership on workplace strategy and employee experience

_______________________________________________________________________

We are looking for an experienced Partner Sales Manager, Mid-Enterprise to drive partner-led growth across Docker’s Mid-Enterprise business.

The primary focus of this role will be generating pipeline for Docker’s AI Governance solution. Working closely with Docker’s Mid-Enterprise sales organization and priority channel partners, you will develop scalable sales plays, activate joint campaigns, and advance partner-sourced and partner-influenced opportunities from identification through close.

You will own a partner revenue target focused on pipeline and ARR, transforming successful partner engagements into repeatable programs that expand market coverage and scale across sellers, partners, and regions.

 
 

Responsibilities

Partner Strategy & Execution

  • Develop and execute a Mid-Enterprise partner plan aligned with Docker’s go-to-market strategy and revenue goals.

  • Prioritize the partners, markets, and use cases with the greatest potential to generate pipeline at scale.

  • Build strong relationships with priority resellers, solution providers, and distributors.

  • Establish clear operating cadences covering joint planning, pipeline, forecasting, enablement, and performance.

Scalable Partner-Led Growth

  • Create repeatable partner sales plays that drive account engagement and qualified pipeline.

  • Lead account mapping and prioritization with partners and Docker sales teams.

  • Activate joint campaigns, events, workshops, and outbound programs with Partner Marketing and Demand Generation.

  • Build the playbooks, messaging, training, and engagement workflows required for consistent execution.

  • Measure and refine programs based on adoption, conversion, pipeline contribution, and revenue.

Pipeline & Co-Sell Execution

  • Own partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline generation and ARR.

  • Connect partners with Docker sellers and drive joint opportunities through qualification, progression, and close.

  • Maintain regular pipeline and forecast reviews with priority partners and sales leadership.

  • Identify risks, remove blockers, and implement actions that improve conversion and deal velocity.

  • Ensure partner activity is connected to measurable commercial outcomes.

AI Governance & Solution Positioning

  • Enable partners to position Docker as trusted infrastructure for secure and governed AI-assisted software development.

  • Translate Docker’s AI governance strategy into practical customer use cases and repeatable partner conversations.

  • Identify segments and opportunities where AI adoption, governance, or software supply-chain security create customer urgency.

  • Partner with Product Marketing and technical teams to develop sales plays, workshops, and enablement assets.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner closely with Sales, Marketing, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, and Revenue Operations.

  • Align direct sellers and partners around target accounts, opportunities, and clear rules of engagement.

  • Increase field adoption by making partner programs simple, relevant, and valuable to sellers.

  • Bring partner and market feedback into Docker’s go-to-market planning.

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of enterprise sales, channel sales, alliances, or partner management experience in B2B technology.

  • Proven success generating pipeline and revenue through resellers, solution providers, VARs, or distributors.

  • Experience building scalable partner sales plays and joint demand-generation programs.

  • Strong pipeline management, forecasting, account-mapping, and co-sell experience.

  • Track record of aligning direct sellers and partners around shared revenue goals.

  • Experience in developer tools, DevOps, cloud infrastructure, cybersecurity, or AI technology is preferred.

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience.

Skills & Competencies

  • Outcome-driven, with a strong focus on pipeline, revenue, and customer growth.

  • Able to turn successful partner engagements into repeatable, scalable programs.

  • Commercially rigorous and comfortable owning targets, forecasts, and performance reviews.

  • Strong field operator who can earn seller trust and move opportunities forward.

  • Skilled cross-functional collaborator across sales, marketing, technical teams, and partners.

  • Clear communicator who can translate Docker’s platform and AI governance strategy into customer value.

  • Data-driven and able to focus investment on the partners and programs producing the strongest results.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Docker

Docker has been one of the most loved brands in developer tooling, trusted by more than 20 million monthly users and over 20 billion container image pulls. From solo founders to the world's largest companies, developers rely on Docker to build, share, and run their applications across our suite of products including Docker Desktop, Docker Hub, and Docker Scout.

We are a globally distributed, remote-first team building the tools that define how software gets built and delivered. As AI agents redefine software development, Docker is at the center of that shift, providing the sandboxed environments, verified images, and secure infrastructure that make autonomous workflows trustworthy by default.

_______________________________________________________________________

Docker is launching a Professional Services organization to accelerate customer success, reduce time-to-value, and drive enterprise adoption for agentic workloads. As a Principal Solution Architect, you'll play a critical role in building and scaling this function. You will join a team of seasoned experts with deep experience backed by Docker's unmatched reach across Fortune 500 companies.

This is a high-visibility role working directly with senior leadership across revenue, product, marketing, and partner organizations. You'll shape service strategy, drive cross-functional alignment, and deliver offerings that accelerate both services revenue and platform expansion.

You'll serve as a trusted advisor to our largest and most strategic partners and enterprise customers, providing thought leadership on integrating Docker agentic solutions within enterprise environments.

Responsibilities

Build and Scale the Professional Services Practice

  • Develop and codify repeatable reference architecture patterns across Docker's core use cases including self-hosted and air-gapped deployments, MCP (model context protocol)/AI agent environments, IDP integrations, and secure supply chain workflows so that engagements scale consistently across customers and partners.

  • Translate reference architectures into customer-facing technical collateral, SOW templates, and success patterns that reduce scoping time and improve delivery consistency.

  • Collaborate with product, marketing, and revenue teams to integrate services into GTM motions and align delivery to Docker's AI platform roadmap.

  • Identify offerings that drive product expansion, renewals, and long-term customer value.

  • Support Partnerships & Alliances in selecting, onboarding, and enabling technical integration partners, system integrators (SIs), and service delivery partners.

Drive Strategic Customer Outcomes

  • Act as a trusted advisor to enterprise customers, helping them adopt modern patterns for containerization, AI workflows, and secure software supply chains.

  • Lead technical discovery and architecture engagements that span enterprise integration layers

  • Architect and deliver self-hosted Docker deployments within air-gapped, regulated, and complex enterprise environments including local image registry setup, offline toolchain configuration, and compliance-driven infrastructure design.

  • Design and Guide customers through implementation of agentic AI toolchains, including MCP server/client architecture, tool orchestration, observability integration and secure deployment patterns aligned to Docker's AI platform.

  • Position Docker as a strategic and thought leadership partner, influencing long-term technology adoption and investment decisions.

  • Directly deliver or assign and oversee appropriate delivery partners to execute service engagements and ensure technical objectives are met.

Enable Cross-Functional Success

  • Drive alignment and decision-making across multiple stakeholders and teams without direct reporting lines.

  • Translate field insights including enterprise integration patterns, IDP/SSO friction points, observability gaps, and AI deployment challenges into actionable product and services strategy, roadmap, and partner capabilities.

Qualifications

Required

  • 7+ years as a Professional Services Solution Architect, Technical Consultant, or similar role at a SaaS/infrastructure company or consulting firm.

  • Demonstrated experience architecting and deploying self-hosted and air-gapped deployment architectures: local image registries, offline toolchain configuration, network-isolated Kubernetes clusters, and compliance-driven infrastructure constraints common in regulated industries.

  • Enterprise integration experience across Identity Providers (Okta, Azure AD, LDAP/Active Directory) and federated identity protocols (OIDC, SAML, SSO), including RBAC design within complex, multi-tenant enterprise environments.

  • Working knowledge of Model Context Protocol (MCP) and its application to agentic AI toolchains including MCP server/client architecture, tool and resource orchestration, and secure containerized deployment patterns.

  • Hands-on experience with AI/ML workflows, LLM deployment, and agentic AI architectures in enterprise environments with awareness of Docker's AI platform roadmap including AI agent containerization, model provenance, and AI supply chain security.

  • Deep understanding of container and software supply chain security: Docker Hardened Images (DHI), Secure Supply Chain (SSC), SBOM generation, image signing and attestation, vulnerability management, and runtime governance.

  • Excellent facilitation and stakeholder management skills; able to lead executive-level architecture conversations and influence senior stakeholders without formal authority.

  • Direct experience delivering high-quality services engagements that achieve customer value while meeting revenue and ARR growth targets within a revenue organization.

  • Recognition by enterprise customers as a strategic technical advisor.

Bonus

  • Experience architecting AI platforms in large enterprise environments LLM deployment pipelines, model provenance, artifact signing, and secure AI supply chain patterns.

  • Background enabling system integrators, consultancies, or partner ecosystems.

  • Consulting experience with Fortune 500 clients in highly regulated sectors such as financial services, healthcare, or government.

  • Led AI security architecture engagements that addressed model provenance, artifact signing, and supply chain integrity for containerized AI workloads including secure MCP server deployment, tool and resource access controls, secrets management within agentic pipelines, and runtime isolation patterns for LLM-based applications.

What to Expect

First 30 Days

  • Onboard to Docker's mission, values, and operating model.

  • Deeply familiarize yourself with our product portfolio, AI platform roadmap, and strategic customers.

  • Build strong partnerships with Product, Engineering, and Sales functions.

  • Plug into the team's rhythm of business (standups, reviews, shadow customer engagements).

First 90 Days

  • Scope, define SOWs, delivery, and oversight of customer service engagements.

  • Participate in the creation of reference architectures for key use cases..

  • Participate in initiatives to build out and improve the services department's offerings.

One-Year Outlook

  • Successful delivery and oversight of customer service engagements.

  • Contribute materially to the build-out of Docker's service offerings across AI, security, and enterprise integration practices.

  • Institutionalize continuous improvement by providing field feedback including enterprise integration patterns, deployment blockers, and observability gaps to the product team.

Docker does not offer visa sponsorship for this role.

 

Compensation & Equity

Canada: CA$238,000– CA$340,000 + equity

United States: $171,500 – $245,00 + equity

  • Open vacancy: This posting is for an existing open role.

  • AI in hiring: Docker may use AI-assisted tools during our recruiting process.

______________________________________________________________________

  • Remote-first by design – Work from your home, with offices in Seattle and Paris for connection and collaboration.

  • Flexibility that fits your life – We trust you to manage your schedule while delivering great work.

  • Time to recharge – Generous PTO, designated quarterly Whaleness Days, and a designated end-of-year Whaleness break.

  • Home office support – Set up your workspace for comfort and success.

  • Technology stipend – Equivalent to US$100 net per month to help support your work.

  • Learning & development – Annual stipend for conferences, courses, certifications, and continued learning.

  • Parental leave – 16 weeks of paid parental leave after six months of employment.

We're looking for a Senior Manager, Business Systems to lead our Salesforce development and administration team and drive the architecture, roadmap, and day-to-day operational health of our Salesforce instance. This is a hands-on technical management role: you'll manage a team of Salesforce developers and administrators, stay close to code and configuration, and also own a small set of adjacent RevOps tools that round out the GTM systems stack. You'll report to the Director, Business Systems and partner closely with Sales, Operations, Marketing, Customer Success, Finance, and Security leadership.

  • Manage and grow a team of Salesforce developers and administrators, including hiring, performance management, career development, and day-to-day prioritization of their work

  • Own the Salesforce platform roadmap across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, CPQ, and integrated third-party systems, balancing production support, technical debt reduction, and net-new delivery

  • Stay hands-on with architecture and code review for Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Flow automation, and platform security, guiding your team's technical decisions rather than delegating them entirely

  • Own the Salesforce DevOps and release management lifecycle: Gearset administration, source control, testing frameworks, CI/CD pipelines, deployment governance, and production change management, including planning around end-of-quarter production freezes

  • Pair heavily with the Technical Architect to execute against their architectural roadmap, with dotted-line accountability for delivering their priorities through your team while retaining direct management authority over your reports

  • Maintain governance over Salesforce data architecture, security model, sharing rules, profiles, permission sets, and integration/service account hygiene across connected systems

  • Own or co-own supporting integrations between Salesforce and platforms

  • Own a set of adjacent RevOps tools outside Salesforce (e.g., Gearset, Gong, Loom) and coordinate with other owners

  • Manage Agentforce, Slackbot, AI skills, and other AI-driven Salesforce offerings, and evaluate new AI-driven workflow opportunities on the platform

  • Partner with GTM stakeholders to gather requirements and translate business needs into technical solutions delivered by your team

  • Set team standards for documentation, testing, and change management, and enforce operating rules for high-risk changes (e.g., Closed/Won opportunity edits, ownership changes) to protect data integrity and downstream automation

  • Escalate and resolve complex production issues, serving as the team's senior technical point of contact

  • 5+ years total hands-on Salesforce development experience in enterprise environments and people management

  • Deep expertise with Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), SOQL/SOSL, Salesforce APIs, Flow automation, and platform security

  • Experience with Salesforce CPQ and billing systems

  • Experience with RevOps or quote-to-cash processes

  • Strong understanding of Salesforce DevOps and CI/CD practices (Gearset or similar)

  • Experience working in high-growth SaaS or technology companies, ideally supporting a globally distributed GTM organization

  • Strong analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills; comfortable balancing people management with hands-on technical work

Nice to Have

  • Salesforce Platform Developer I or II, or Salesforce Administrator certification

  • Familiarity with NetSuite and quote-to-cash business processes and Mulesoft

  • Familiarity with data warehousing, analytics, or AI-driven workflows

  • Experience supporting global sales organizations

What to Expect

First 30 days:

  • Meet your direct reports and the broader Business Systems team; build 1:1 cadences

  • Assess team workload, skill gaps, and open production support items

  • Get up to speed on the Salesforce instance, code base, best practices, and current roadmap

  • Introduce yourself to cross-functional stakeholders the Salesforce team supports

First 60 days:

  • Dive deep into the technical architecture to evaluate performance and identify refactor opportunities

  • Establish a regular working cadence with the Technical Architect to align on roadmap priorities and execution ownership

  • Engage with key stakeholder leaders across the organization

  • Establish or reinforce best practices to keep the instance performant, secure, and scalable

One year outlook:

  • Have a high-performing, well-supported team delivering to roadmap independently

  • Own the Salesforce ecosystem as it relates to third-party tooling, integrations, and upstream/downstream dependencies

  • Be the go-to subject matter expert for the Salesforce instance and its surrounding systems

About Docker

Docker has been one of the most loved brands in developer tooling, trusted by more than 20 million monthly users and over 20 billion container image pulls. From solo founders to the world's largest companies, developers rely on Docker to build, share, and run their applications across our suite of products including Docker Desktop, Docker Hub, and Docker Scout.

_______________________________________________________________________

Docker is looking for a Sales Enablement Specialist to support the day-to-day enablement needs of our Go-To-Market (GTM) organization. Reporting to the Head of Sales Enablement, you will manage core enablement systems, run role-specific new hire onboarding, organize and execute trainings, build the reporting that shows how enablement is landing with the field, and help keep the enablement team operating smoothly.

This is a great role for an enablement practitioner who enjoys variety — one day you’re pulling a Gong and Mindtickle report — translating data to strategic action, the next you’re running a live onboarding session with new hires, and the next you’re partnering with Marketing on a launch. If you’re organized, resourceful, and energized by helping the sales team succeed, this role is for you.

Responsibilities

Systems & Administration

  • Own day-to-day administration of Mindtickle and other enablement systems: content, users, assignments, and reporting.

  • Keep enablement systems organized, up to date, and easy for the field to navigate.

  • Troubleshoot access and content issues, and act as the go-to point of contact for tool support.

New Hire Onboarding & Ramp

  • Build and run role-specific onboarding programs for new Sales and GTM hires, from curriculum design through live facilitation.

  • Meet regularly with new hires throughout ramp to check progress, answer questions, and be their go-to guide through onboarding.

  • Directly train new hires on core systems and processes (e.g., Salesforce, Mindtickle, Gong, and sales workflows) as part of onboarding.

  • Arrange and coordinate subject matter experts from Sales, Product, and other teams to support onboarding training and education needs.

  • Maintain onboarding curricula and materials, updating them as products, tools, and processes evolve.

  • Track new hire progress and readiness, flagging gaps to managers and enablement leadership.

Sales Insights & Reporting

  • Build, monitor, and maintain reporting on enablement program participation, completion, and effectiveness across Mindtickle and other systems.

  • Partner with Sales leadership to translate Gong call analytics and other field data into actionable insights on rep performance, messaging adoption, and skill gaps.

  • Use enablement and conversation intelligence data to identify where the GTM team needs more support, and recommend enablement programs to close the gaps.

  • Present reporting and insights to enablement and Sales leadership to inform program priorities.

Training & Program Execution

  • Organize and execute ongoing sales enablement trainings, workshops, and certifications for the field.

  • Handle logistics for enablement programs: scheduling, communications, materials, and follow-up.

  • Create sales enablement content as needed — quick-reference guides, updates, and job aids.

Cross-Functional Support & Operations

  • Work cross-functionally with Marketing, Product, and other stakeholders to support enablement needs.

  • Support the operational backbone of the Enablement team: calendars, budgets, and program tracking.

  • Gather feedback data to help the team continuously improve programs.

Qualifications

Required

  • 2+ years of experience in sales enablement, sales operations, learning & development, or a related role, ideally in SaaS.

  • Hands-on experience administering an LMS or sales enablement platform (Mindtickle strongly preferred).

  • Experience supporting or running onboarding programs for a sales or GTM team, including live facilitation.

  • Experience building or interpreting reporting on enablement participation, completion, and program effectiveness.

  • Familiarity with conversation intelligence platforms such as Gong (or similar), and using call data to surface coaching and enablement insights.

  • Strong organizational and project management skills — you can juggle multiple programs and deadlines.

  • Comfortable creating content, including documents, guides, and presentations.

  • Excellent communication skills and a service-minded, “how can I help” approach to the field.

  • Ability to work cross-functionally with Marketing, Product, and Sales leadership.

Strongly Preferred

  • Direct experience administering Mindtickle and Gong (or a similar sales engagement/conversation intelligence platform).

  • Experience designing or facilitating live or virtual sales training sessions.

  • Familiarity with sales methodologies such as Command of the Message or similar frameworks.

  • Comfort working with reporting or BI tools (e.g., Excel, Google Sheets, Tableau, Sigma) to build enablement dashboards.

  • Exposure to containerization, DevOps tooling, or developer platforms (Docker experience a significant plus).

What to Expect

We believe in setting people up to win. Here’s what great looks like in this role:

First 30 Days — Learn & Listen

  • Ramp on Docker’s products, GTM motion, and current enablement programs and systems.

  • Shadow onboarding sessions and get hands-on in Mindtickle and Gong.

  • Build relationships across Sales, Marketing, Product, and the Enablement team.

First 90 Days — Take Ownership

  • Own day-to-day Mindtickle administration and at least one full onboarding cohort, including live sessions and 1:1s with new hires.

  • Stand up an initial enablement reporting view covering participation, completion, and Gong-based insights.

  • Independently execute a training or certification program for the field.

First Year — Drive Impact

  • Be the trusted owner of enablement systems, onboarding, and reporting, with new hires ramping faster and leadership relying on your insights.

  • Run trainings and programs independently and be seen as a dependable Enablement partner.

  • Use enablement and Gong data to proactively recommend where the GTM team needs more support.

Docker does not offer visa sponsorship for this role.

 

Compensation & Equity

Canada: CA$135,100– CA$193,000 + equity

United States: $97,300 – $139,00 + equity

______________________________________________________________________

  • Open vacancy: This posting is for an existing open role.

  • AI in hiring: Docker may use AI-assisted tools during our recruiting process.

  • Interview recordings: Candidates will be invited to opt in to interview recordings to support interviewer calibration and consistent evaluations. Recordings are optional and require explicit consent.

______________________________________________________________________

Perks & Benefits

  • Remote-first by design – Work from your home, with offices in Seattle and Paris for connection and collaboration.

  • Flexibility that fits your life – We trust you to manage your schedule while delivering great work.

  • Time to recharge – Generous PTO, designated quarterly Whaleness Days, and a designated end-of-year Whaleness break.

  • Home office support – Set up your workspace for comfort and success.

  • Technology stipend – Equivalent to US$100 net per month to help support your work.

  • Learning & development – Annual stipend for conferences, courses, certifications, and continued learning.

  • Parental leave – 16 weeks of paid parental leave after six months of employment.

  • Equity for all full-time employees – Share in Docker's long-term success as we continue to grow.

  • Comprehensive benefits – Medical, retirement, and paid holidays vary by country.

  • Docker swag – Because representing the whale never gets old.
